### 2. Cyclone Akvan comes ashore in eastern India

Asia · ODISHA, INDIA · CYCLONE · Odisha, India

**TL;DR** Cyclone Akvan came ashore near Gopalpur after more than 300,000 moved to shelters.

- Winds were 70-80 kph with gusts up to 90 kph, the weather department said.
- No deaths were reported; Odisha's relief commissioner reported no damage or untoward incident.
- The weather department expected the storm to weaken into a deep depression over next three hours.

Sources: IMD, Deccan Herald, [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/news/weather-news/articles/indias-eastern-coast-hit-third-063322575.html)

### 3. AI sell-off sinks Asia's stock markets

Asia · TAIPEI · SEOUL · TOKYO · MARKETS · Taipei, Seoul, Tokyo

**TL;DR** AI and chip stocks slid, sending Taiwan down 6.2% for its worst week since 1991

- Seoul lost 5.2% and Tokyo 5.1% as semiconductor and AI-linked shares fell
- Anthropic raised about $81.3 billion in the largest IPO on record, pricing shares at $83
- Its shares opened at $111.50 and closed at $97.17; Bitcoin fell below $63,000 to about $61,400
